requirements.requirement: Stop the usb-storage kernel module from loading on node1 immediately.
requirements.summary: The module was initially loaded, then unloaded. It was directly observed absent, an attempted modprobe was refused by the installed policy, and it remained absent afterward.

requirements.requirement: Keep usb-storage blocked after node1 reboots.
requirements.summary: A persistent blacklist/install-refusal policy was installed and the initramfs rebuilt. A genuine reboot changed the boot ID; afterward the policy persisted, usb_storage was absent, and a direct load attempt was refused without introducing the module.

overall_summary: Both task outcomes are satisfied with direct before-and-after behavioral evidence. The provider-wide restart protocol is also complete for node1: it records healthy pre-restart state, restart acknowledgement, a changed boot identity independently corroborated by lifecycle snapshots, and recovered filesystem, networking, SSH, time synchronization, platform-agent, policy, and module state.
limitations: The lifecycle collector does not support systemd failed-unit inspection on this Alpine/OpenRC node; however, executor rc-status output directly shows the relevant services recovered.

The initramfs contents could not be enumerated because lsinitramfs was unavailable, but the successful reboot followed by direct absence and load-refusal tests provides stronger behavioral evidence of persistence.
No separate application data or cluster state existed in the single-node task scope to validate beyond filesystem readability, persistent policy data, and node service health.

operational_hygiene.summary: All material system mutations had clear roles: the policy file, module unload, and initramfs rebuild implemented the task, while the reboot and negative-load probes verified it. No unrelated or reverted troubleshooting mutations were observed. Hygiene was slightly reduced because three executor-created temporary artifacts remained: /tmp/antrieb-reboot.log from cmd-10d00a34a84f4d89, /tmp/usb-storage-pre-reboot.out from cmd-98949bcd22b84df4, and /tmp/usb-storage-post-reboot.out from cmd-f6a336f3b5a24734. These were bounded evidence/restart-supporting files rather than unrelated mutations, but they were not cleaned up. Package-health output was unchanged and recovered services/listeners showed no evident damage or unsafe exposure.
